elevate.move: Replace the generic photo in .services-break with a typographic interstitial using an oversized marker primitive reading Under the oaks / Quercus virginiana / Deep shade, threading the signature through the grid break at the exact density point.
Refactor .plant-card to extend .marker so filter output cards are literal instances of the signature primitive, making the interactive moment inseparable from the design identity.
